title: Preserve removal of already displayed edited notifications
body:
## Problem

An already displayed notification can remain visible after it is removed. If an `updateNotification` edit is queued before its removal, cancelling that edit incorrectly records its ID as a cancelled addition. The subsequent removal is then stripped from `updateNotificationGroup`.

## Fix

Do not treat a cancelled edit as a never-delivered addition. Keep the removal for an already displayed notification. Actual pending additions still record their IDs, so an undelivered add/edit/remove sequence continues to cancel completely.

This is the standalone extraction of `df5ef75` from #3766, rebased onto `master` at `ea3f69c`. It changes only `NotificationManager.cpp` and does not depend on the forum-specific changes in that PR.

## Verification

- Local C++ regression harness using the exact production helper: **19/19 assertions pass**; the same harness reproduces **4 failures on the unmodified base**. Cases include displayed and undelivered notifications, mixed queues, duplicate edits, repeated cancellation and group isolation. TD API containers, queue storage and logging use test doubles.
- Regenerated sources from this branch and compiled `NotificationManager.cpp` for Android ARM64/API 21 (NDK r30) and ARMv7/API 16 (NDK r23). Both object compilations pass; no full-library link was performed.
- `git diff --check` and changed-line `clang-format` checks pass. The patch is identical to the original commit.

These are targeted checks, not a full TDLib test run or a device test of this standalone branch. Implementation and local regression checks are LLM-assisted.

title: Don't lose promises after an empty one in on_get_monoforum_topic.
body:
`getDirectMessagesChatTopic` can abort the process with

```
[ 0][Td.cpp:1445] Lost promise for query 6 of type 1990530052 in close state 0
```

`add_topic` starts `reload_monoforum_topic(..., Auto())` for a direct messages topic that was not received from the server, so an empty promise becomes the first entry of `get_topic_queries_`. A `getDirectMessagesChatTopic` for the same topic, sent while that reload is in flight, is queued behind it. When the reload finishes, the loop in `on_get_monoforum_topic` hits the empty promise and `return`s, so every promise after it is destroyed unset. `Td::send_error_impl` then treats the lost request promise as fatal.

Reproduced on 1.8.69 with a fresh client, as the administrator of a channel with direct messages:

1. `getChat` for the direct messages chat whose last message is in a topic not loaded from the server yet. This adds the topic and starts the automatic reload.
2. Right away, `getDirectMessagesChatTopic` for that topic.

The fix skips empty promises instead of leaving the loop.

title: Extract the topic list ordering from SavedMessagesManager
body:
Move the ordering of a topic list out of `SavedMessagesManager` into `OrderedTopics<TopicIdT>`, a header-only class like `SetWithPosition`: the ordered set of topics, the boundary of the loaded part of the list with the public order that follows from it, the server-side total count, and the list of pinned topics. Saved Messages and channel direct messages topics use it as before, with no change in behavior.

This is the first step towards a topic list maintained by TDLib for forum topics too, which can then use the same class keyed by `ForumTopicId` instead of a copy of this code. The class has randomized and hand-written tests in `test/ordered_topics.cpp`.

title: Allow raw NFT addresses in setTonWalletCardStickers
body: getTonWalletNfts returns NFT addresses in raw form (`0:<hex>`), as the server sends them in wallet.nftItem, but setTonWalletCardStickers accepted only user-friendly addresses, so passing an address from getTonWalletNfts failed with "Invalid address length".
